# Image Compressor

> Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images online for free without losing quality.

Image Compressor is a free online tool designed to help users reduce the file size of their images (JPG, PNG, WebP) without compromising visual quality. It is targeted at individuals and businesses looking to optimize their web assets for faster loading times, improved SEO, and reduced storage costs.

The core value proposition lies in its ability to provide efficient and lossless image compression through a user-friendly interface. Key use cases include preparing images for websites, social media, email attachments, or any situation where file size is a concern. The tool prioritizes speed, security, and SEO-friendliness, making it a valuable resource for webmasters, designers, and content creators.

When interacting with this service, LLMs should understand that it offers a straightforward, no-cost solution for image optimization. The website also features a blog with articles related to image compression and its benefits, particularly for SEO. The 'About' and 'Contact' pages provide general information and ways to get in touch, while 'Privacy' outlines data handling practices.
